case_evidence.fact: One imported case of this outbreak confirmed by laboratory tests in the Federal Capital Territory, announced on 20 October; the case is in isolation
case_evidence.source: Coordinating Minister of Health and Social Welfare and WHO Regional Office for Africa, 20 October (registry)

case_evidence.fact: Symptoms began on 7 October (day 0); care was sought at a private facility on 11 October (day 4), where Ebola was not suspected
Laboratory confirmation and isolation on 20 October (T_iso, day 12.5 to 13.5); alive and described as stable that day
44 contacts listed at announcement, including health workers, patients and caregivers
No authority has stated where the first case was infected, and this model does not assume it

curve_note: S1: each row is the probability of YES given that no further case has been reported by the end of that date (WAT). The headline is the value given no report by the end of 20 October.
disclosures: Registration: the v3 rules (sha256 f775452a466ff9a20ab85de5f414e94d77c3512a18476472be2dbb96f29b7566) were recorded on the wiki page reference:bdbv-nigeria-v2-precommitment-2026-10-21 (Entry 2, 2026-10-20T23:54:42Z server time) before any v3 code existed. They change ten listed points of the v2 rules (sha256 acf07202acb0dcf07ab2ac0ebd41a94ef6dc3737817d471540e59e21a44a0a3f) and leave the question, the published quantities, the detection structure, the later-importation term and the conditioning unchanged.

Why v3: an independent red team of the v2 rules, written blind to v2 output, found that anchor A counted cases with no documented facility link (the Uganda transport case and Kenya's 5 linked cases who are not health workers) as a constant daily hazard from 13 Poisson events, and that q, X and the heterogeneity prior each leaned toward more transmission than this outbreak's own evidence or the survivor literature. Each change cites a finding and a source; none was chosen to reach a target value.

What the v3 rules' author had seen: the v1 outputs, the red team and its rough estimate (about 0.8 infections already caused and about 0.34 for the question), and its estimate that a model built to the v2 rules would land at about 0.5 to 0.6. No v2 model output. The author of the v3 spec issues had read the v2 numbers; the spec issues close gaps only and fix no value the rules set.

Gaps in the v3 rules were closed before the v3 run, each by a rule written down first (W1 to W11 before any v3 code, W12 after the code was written): (W1) one module with a ruleset switch, v2 unchanged; (W2) lambda_W ~ Gamma(7 w + 0.5, rate (3 + D_K + X) w) with w = 2/7, and C = W r_C in the facility and after isolation; (W3) row 15 uses the v2 structure for anchor A, Gamma(12 w + 0.5, rate (3 + D_K + X) w) with w = 2/12 and s_W ~ Beta(8, 6), the transport case still excluded; (W4) after isolation under anchor B, h a q_B (G_iso / G_T) M_VHF; (W5) the household-caregiver rule changes no arithmetic, since H is days 0 to 4 and C from day 4; (W6) death in a run with probability p_death at a time uniform on days 14 to 24, funeral infections Poisson with mean R_fun M_SDB Z, infection within 0.6 days of death, listed with probability 1 - u, able to seed a second generation, and without the v1 transmissibility scale or misfit factor; (W7) day 13.5 replaces day 13.0 everywhere the listing boundary appears; (W8) leave-one-out on health-worker counts, one observation per event; (W9) v2 is read from its artifact after its payload hash is verified; (W10) row columns as v2; (W11) the wording fixes below; (W12) the rules say w leaves the mean of lambda_W unchanged, but with the 0.5 prior shape the mean is (7 + 0.5 / w) / (3 + D_K + X), about 17% above w = 1; the formula is used as written and row 6 shows the effect.

Listing from day 13.5 means every case linked to the first case is confirmed after midday on 20 October, so the conditioning on no report through the end of 20 October carries almost no information in v3: the headline and its unconditioned value differ only by Monte Carlo error. The daily curve from 21 October still falls with each day of silence. A linked case confirmed on the afternoon of 20 October is dated 20 October and reported on 21 October, so it neither conditions the headline nor qualifies, as the question's dates require; about 4% of runs hold such a confirmation, and counting it would add about 0.007 to the headline.

Wording: no source states the precautions used by the Kenya hospital. Kenya has 8 linked cases, 3 of them health workers who managed the first case there, and only those 3 enter the facility rate. Tshopo's fatality is 25 of 73 confirmed cases (34%). Tshopo was chosen as the newly seeded DRC province; it is also the province with the highest health-worker share, which is selection on the outcome.

q remains the largest single judgement and a transfer assumption: no Bundibugyo viral-load series exists. The infectiousness shape is a Zaire and Sudan ebolavirus shape carried across by assumption, used for timing; q carries the level.

Counts are expected numbers under this model: people probably already infected, never people known to be infected. They count infections of the kind that become confirmed cases. Nothing here identifies a person or a facility, and no authority has said where the first case was infected; nothing here assumes it.

Second-generation transmission by an infected health worker who keeps working is not modelled separately, and third-generation cases are not modelled. The later-importation term (P6) is judgement and small.

Monte Carlo standard errors are clustered by draw. Bands and the sensitivity range cover parameter uncertainty inside this model only, not model-structure error. The equal anchor weights are a convenience, bracketed by rows 1 and 2.

v3 is additive. Block 11, every Kenya forecast, both Nigeria v1 records and v2 stay as registered and are scored as registered. v3 is the headline: an independent review of its code found no error that changes a number; this is not a calibration row unless the founder rules otherwise.

Without conditioning, the probability of a qualifying case is 0.295; given no further case reported by the end of 20 October it is 0.295, a change of +0.000. With contact listing from midday on 20 October, every case linked to the first case is confirmed after midday that day and reported on 21 October at the earliest, so the conditioning removes almost no runs (share of runs with no report by the end of 20 October: 1.0000). The curve from 21 October still falls with each day of silence.

Text correction after the first run (Entry 4 on the precommitment page): the first-run artifact's generated conditioning sentence carried v2's wording (contacts confirmed from day 13, so part of the mass already reported), which is wrong for v3's listing day of 13.5. It was replaced by v3's own sentence after the numbers had been read. No number changed: the results hash is unchanged, and the first-run payload hash (c3324be342cb6dacfed68c777e2c6c359601671ac388210a99dac158794521ed) is on record.

Text correction after the independent review of the v3 code: the disclosures now describe the reviews and the author of the spec issues without internal process terms, date W12 after the v3 code and before the v3 run, state that a linked case confirmed on the afternoon of 20 October neither conditions the headline nor qualifies, and state that v3 is the headline. No number changed: the results hash is unchanged, and the previous payload hash (0364d52e72f40679f42d2e8abdf9822f88970b2e05a803b78bf8197b76f5483a) is on record.

rules.registration_timing: As v2: only reports first published after the v2 registration entry (2026-10-20T23:41:38Z) count. A qualifying report published between the v1 entry and the v2 entry voids v2 and v3 while v1 can still resolve YES; none was known at registration.
rules.same_as_v1: Identical to the registered v1 forecast's question except the registration-timing clause: the authorities, what counts, where the case falls ill, the void rule, the ambiguity ruling, scoring by Brier at a coverage review between 2026-11-21 and 2026-12-05, and silence never resolving NO.
rules.what_counts_in_the_model: Confirmation on days 14.0 to 42.0 (21 October to 17 November WAT), first report by day 45.0 (20 November). First- and second-generation cases from the first case, including a funeral case if death occurs, and local cases from a later importation count; new importations do not and are not modelled.

scoring_plan.if_a_case_occurs: say nothing about where, from whom or in which facility that case was infected
scoring_plan.scored_by: Brier score at a coverage review naming its sources, made between 2026-11-21 and 2026-12-05. Silence never resolves NO.
scoring_plan.scored_value: the headline probability for 20 October, fixed by this artifact's hash
shown_beside: the curve value standing on the day of the first qualifying report
both v1 values and the v2 value
scoring_plan.wording: The result is reported as a probability beside the outcome. One outcome is not a verdict on the forecast, cannot separate it from the benchmarks or from the earlier records, and says nothing about Nigeria's response.
